name: v21b_milli50
description: Long-window model: millipede settles ~ proportional to litter throughput (regen x piles). 20 piles x 0.004 -> ~135. Target ~50 => throughput ~0.03 => litter_regen_per_tick 0.0015. Verify at LONG timescale (the equilibrium takes ~24 game-days to reach). No species throttles.
